dialogues.jp:
風見学園には、俺が足を踏み入れることがない
場所が３つある。
dialogues.en:
There are only three places in Kazami Academy that I have
never set foot in.
dialogues.text:
There are only three places in Kazami Academy that I have
never set foot in.

dialogues.jp: 女子トイレと、女子更衣室と、図書室だ。
dialogues.en:
The girl's bathroom, the girl's locker room, and the
library.
dialogues.text:
The girl's bathroom, the girl's locker room, and the
library.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、そうは言っても、用事があれば、絶対に
行かないと言う訳ではない。
dialogues.en:
Well, more accurately, if I don't have a specific reason to
go there, I never will.
dialogues.text:
Well, more accurately, if I don't have a specific reason to
go there, I never will.

dialogues.jp: 前者ふたつは、さすがに入ったことはないな。
dialogues.en:
Of course, for the first two, there's absolutely no reason
for me to enter.
dialogues.text:
Of course, for the first two, there's absolutely no reason
for me to enter.

dialogues.jp: ……いや、昼寝をしに、時々来るな。
dialogues.en:
But there is for the last. For example, when I need to take
a lunchtime nap.
dialogues.text:
But there is for the last. For example, when I need to take
a lunchtime nap.

dialogues.jp:
さて、そんな俺が図書室に来た理由は、今回は
ただひとつ。
dialogues.en:
However, this time, my reason for going there was slightly
different--
dialogues.text:
However, this time, my reason for going there was slightly
different--

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんゴメン。私ひとりじゃこれ運べなくて」
dialogues.en: "Nii-san, could you...? I can't bring these over by myself."
dialogues.text: "Nii-san, could you...? I can't bring these over by myself."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「４時限目に使った国語辞典か？」
dialogues.en: "The dictionaries we used for fourth period?"
dialogues.text: "The dictionaries we used for fourth period?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そう。ちょっと量が多くて」
dialogues.en: "Yes, there's a lot of them..."
dialogues.text: "Yes, there's a lot of them..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「他にも言いつけられたヤツいなかったか？」
dialogues.en: "There isn't anyone else you can ask?"
dialogues.text: "There isn't anyone else you can ask?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「その……、ほら紫さん細いから大変そうで
　しょ？　私、つい変わってあげるって言っ
　ちゃって」
dialogues.en:
"Well... look at Murasaki-san for yourself, do you think she
could? I don't have the heart to ask her."
dialogues.text:
"Well... look at Murasaki-san for yourself, do you think she
could? I don't have the heart to ask her."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「自業自得だ。自分も身体弱いクセに、ヘンに
　いいカッコしようとするからだろ」
dialogues.en:
"You should pay for your own mistakes. You knew you weren't
going to be able to do it, yet volunteered so eagerly for
it."
dialogues.text:
"You should pay for your own mistakes. You knew you weren't
going to be able to do it, yet volunteered so eagerly for
it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんですけど……、じゃあ兄さんは私が
　どうなってもいいと？」
dialogues.en:
"That's true, but... well, then what do you think I should
do?"
dialogues.text:
"That's true, but... well, then what do you think I should
do?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことは……」
dialogues.en: "Uh, that's..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「可愛い妹が重労働の果てに倒れてしまったら、
　朝倉家はいったいどうなって……」
dialogues.en:
"Letting your adorable sister collapse due to too much hard
labour, what would our family think..."
dialogues.text:
"Letting your adorable sister collapse due to too much hard
labour, what would our family think..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……わかった。わかったよ。図書室まで運べ
　ばいいんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"...Okay, okay, I got it. Just take these to the library,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"...Okay, okay, I got it. Just take these to the library,
right?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「で、なんで俺が全部運ばなきゃならんのだ！」
dialogues.en: "...Then why did I end up carrying all of them!?"
dialogues.text: "...Then why did I end up carrying all of them!?"

dialogues.jp:
結局、手伝ってやると言うより、肩代わりとい
う方が正しいという感じだ。
dialogues.en: In the end, I was a substitute more than a helper.
dialogues.text: In the end, I was a substitute more than a helper.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、２０冊近くある国語辞典を、棚に収めて
いく。
dialogues.en:
I slowly started to place the 20 dictionaries back on their
respective shelves.
dialogues.text:
I slowly started to place the 20 dictionaries back on their
respective shelves.

dialogues.jp:
今晩はたっぷりとサービスしてもらわないと割
に合わないな。
dialogues.en: She owes me one hell of a take-out for this tonight...
dialogues.text: She owes me one hell of a take-out for this tonight...

dialogues.jp:
ふと、窓際に見覚えのある女の子が座って本を
読んでいるのが見えた。あれは……月城だ。
dialogues.en:
I looked around, and noticed a familiar-looking female
sitting at a desk, and reading a book. ...It's Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
I looked around, and noticed a familiar-looking female
sitting at a desk, and reading a book. ...It's Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
黒い手袋をはめたまま、器用にページをめくっ
ている。
dialogues.en:
Even while wearing the black gloves, she skillfully brushed
past each page.
dialogues.text:
Even while wearing the black gloves, she skillfully brushed
past each page.

dialogues.jp:
読んでいるのは、やたらとでかくて分厚い本だっ
た。
dialogues.en: The book she was reading was nothing short of huge.
dialogues.text: The book she was reading was nothing short of huge.

dialogues.jp: 例の人形は、膝の上に置かれている。
dialogues.en: The usual doll was sitting quietly in her lap.
dialogues.text: The usual doll was sitting quietly in her lap.

dialogues.jp: 「月城、何読んでるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What're you reading, Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text: "What're you reading, Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は本に落ちた俺の影に気づき、ふっと顔を
あげる。
dialogues.en:
Noticing my shadow falling onto her book, she gazed up at
me.
dialogues.text:
Noticing my shadow falling onto her book, she gazed up at
me.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……植物図鑑」
dialogues.en: "...A plant encyclopedia."
dialogues.text: "...A plant encyclopedia."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、めくっていた手をどける。その下には
なにやら、小難しそうな文字の羅列が、落書き
のようなスケッチと一緒に並んでいた。
dialogues.en:
She removed her hand from over the book, to reveal a piece
of paper with a rough sketch of a plant on it.
dialogues.text:
She removed her hand from over the book, to reveal a piece
of paper with a rough sketch of a plant on it.

dialogues.jp:
「こんなの読んでるんだ。もしかして、体育館
　とこの草を調べてんのか？」
dialogues.en:
"So that's what you're looking at... I guess regarding the
plant behind the gym?"
dialogues.text:
"So that's what you're looking at... I guess regarding the
plant behind the gym?"

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: She nodded.
dialogues.text: She nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、あの草の名前、知らないんじゃ」
dialogues.en: "You mean, you don't know that plant's name?"
dialogues.text: "You mean, you don't know that plant's name?"

dialogues.jp: ふるふると首を振る月城。
dialogues.en: A shake of the head no, this time.
dialogues.text: A shake of the head no, this time.

dialogues.jp: 「育て方を調べてるとか？」
dialogues.en:
"Then, you're trying to find out how to take care of it
properly?"
dialogues.text:
"Then, you're trying to find out how to take care of it
properly?"

dialogues.jp: こくこくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: A series of nods again.
dialogues.text: A series of nods again.

dialogues.jp:
「なんかさ……、わかりづらいから、前みたい
　に、人形を使って喋ってくれよ」
dialogues.en:
"Ehhnn... it's hard to talk like this, maybe you should get
your doll to talk again like before."
dialogues.text:
"Ehhnn... it's hard to talk like this, maybe you should get
your doll to talk again like before."

dialogues.jp: 月城の表情が、固くこわばる。
dialogues.en: Her expression suddenly stiffened.
dialogues.text: Her expression suddenly stiffened.

dialogues.jp: そして、辺りを見回す。
dialogues.en: She then took a look around the library.
dialogues.text: She then took a look around the library.

dialogues.jp: 同じように辺りを見回す。
dialogues.en: I did the same as well.
dialogues.text: I did the same as well.

dialogues.jp:
普通に、何人かがおとなしく本を読んでいる。
他には、昼休憩だというのに、カリカリ熱心に
鉛筆を取っているヤツがいるくらいだ。
dialogues.en:
Nothing out of the ordinary. Just a few people quietly
reading books, and a couple of people scribbling furiously
with pencils.
dialogues.text:
Nothing out of the ordinary. Just a few people quietly
reading books, and a couple of people scribbling furiously
with pencils.

dialogues.jp: 「別になんにもないぞ？」
dialogues.en: "There's nothing weird around, is there?"
dialogues.text: "There's nothing weird around, is there?"

dialogues.jp:
すると、月城は少し悲しそうな顔をし、ふるふ
ると首を横に振った。
dialogues.en:
But after her surveying, she sadly shook her head towards
me.
dialogues.text:
But after her surveying, she sadly shook her head towards
me.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...I can't."
dialogues.text: "...I can't."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、視線を本に戻し、またさっきと同じよ
うに本の続きを読み始めた。
dialogues.en:
Returning her eyes to her book, she resumed her vigilant
reading.
dialogues.text:
Returning her eyes to her book, she resumed her vigilant
reading.

dialogues.jp:
何がダメなのかよくわからないが、これ以上月
城は俺と話す気はないっぽいな。
dialogues.en:
I don't know exactly what she can't do, but it seems like
she's in no mood to talk.
dialogues.text:
I don't know exactly what she can't do, but it seems like
she's in no mood to talk.

dialogues.jp: 「邪魔して、悪かったな」
dialogues.en: "Sorry for bothering you."
dialogues.text: "Sorry for bothering you."

dialogues.jp:
本を一生懸命読んでいる月城に、苦笑気味に、
そういい立ち去ることにした。
dialogues.en:
With a touch of bitterness in my words, I started to leave,
as she continued reading as if her life depended on it.
dialogues.text:
With a touch of bitterness in my words, I started to leave,
as she continued reading as if her life depended on it.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.jp: ガラスのようなトーンの声。
dialogues.en: A voice with the tone of glass.
dialogues.text: A voice with the tone of glass.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……サヨナラ」
dialogues.en: "...Farewell."
dialogues.text: "...Farewell."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、立ち上がって、そう言うと、ぺこりと
頭をさげた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro stood up as well as she talked, and bowed.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro stood up as well as she talked, and bowed.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、またな」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, later."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, later."

dialogues.jp:
俺の言葉を聞くと、また何事もなかったように
本を読み始めた。
dialogues.en:
Hearing my farewell as well, she went back to reading her
book, as if nothing had happened.
dialogues.text:
Hearing my farewell as well, she went back to reading her
book, as if nothing had happened.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか拍子抜けしてしまうが、どうやら挨拶
だったらしい。悪くは思われていないようだ。
dialogues.en:
I was a bit disappointed that a goodbye was all she wanted
to say. She probably didn't mean anything bad, though.
dialogues.text:
I was a bit disappointed that a goodbye was all she wanted
to say. She probably didn't mean anything bad, though.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、図書室なんて、俺にとってはさほど面白
い場所ではない。さっさと教室に帰ろう。
dialogues.en:
This place isn't very interesting otherwise. I should just
head back to class.
dialogues.text:
This place isn't very interesting otherwise. I should just
head back to class.

dialogues.jp:
帰り際、受付の女の子がズレるメガネを一生懸
命直しながら、少年雑誌を読んでいたのが印象
的だった。
dialogues.en:
On the way out, I passed by the receptionist, struggling
with keeping her glasses on her face, reading shounen manga.
dialogues.text:
On the way out, I passed by the receptionist, struggling
with keeping her glasses on her face, reading shounen manga.

dialogues.jp: ◆植物図鑑◆
dialogues.en: ◆Plant Eyclopedia◆
dialogues.text: ◆Plant Eyclopedia◆

dialogues.jp: 野暮用で、図書室に行く用事があった。
dialogues.en: I went to the library, with "minor business" to attend to.
dialogues.text: I went to the library, with "minor business" to attend to.

dialogues.jp:
図書室では、月城がなにか植物図鑑のようなも
のを熱心に読んでいた。
dialogues.en:
Inside, I spied Alice, fervently reading a plant
encyclopedia.
dialogues.text:
Inside, I spied Alice, fervently reading a plant
encyclopedia.

dialogues.jp:
月城のことが気になっている俺は、いろいろ｛き／訊｝
いてみはしたのだが、例によってカベを作られ
てしまった。
dialogues.en:
I tried to talk to her about various things, but I couldn't
get past the wall she had erected around herself.
dialogues.text:
I tried to talk to her about various things, but I couldn't
get past the wall she had erected around herself.

dialogues.jp: なかなか難しいものだ。
dialogues.en: She's a difficult one.
dialogues.text: She's a difficult one.
